case_name: Guiram Mondal v State of West Bengal
respondent:
State of West Bengal
Supreme Court of India

26 April 2013
Cr.A. No. 1268 of 2007
The Judgment was delivered by : K. S. Radhakrishnan, J.
1. The appellant, the 10th accused in Sessions Case No.20 of 1986, was charge-sheeted along with
facts: The appellant, Guiram Mondal, was charged with murder and other offenses in connection with the deaths of Amrita Dome and Sultan Khan.
The trial court acquitted all accused persons except Tarun Mondal, who was convicted for causing the murder of Amrita Dome and sentenced to imprisonment for life.
The State of West Bengal appealed the acquittal and the High Court partly allowed the appeal, convicting the appellant and four others.

The prosecution case is that on 26.4.1984 at about 12 hours, the accused persons formed an unlawful assembly with deadly weapons and took Amrita Dome and Sultan Khan through a kuchha road in village Pechaliya.
Some witnesses tried to save Amrita Dome but were also assaulted by the accused persons.
Amrita Dome managed to escape from their clutches and took shelter in the house of Monohar Mondal @ Manu Mondal (PW2).
The accused persons chased Amrita Dome and brought him out of the house and killed him in the passage or pathway lying between the house of Manu Mondal and his nephew Sahadeb Mondal.
Sultan Khan was also murdered by them and they carried away his dead body to a grazing field and left it there.
issues: Whether the trial court erred in acquitting all accused persons except Tarun Mondal?
Whether the High Court correctly allowed the appeal and convicted the appellant and four others?
Whether the FIR was anti-dated, anti-timed or fabricated?
petitioner_arguments: The prosecution case is that on 26.4.1984 at about 12 hours, the accused persons formed an unlawful assembly with deadly weapons and took Amrita Dome and Sultan Khan through a kuchha road in village Pechaliya.
Some witnesses tried to save Amrita Dome but were also assaulted by the accused persons.
Amrita Dome managed to escape from their clutches and took shelter in the house of Monohar Mondal @ Manu Mondal (PW2).
The accused persons chased Amrita Dome and brought him out of the house and killed him in the passage or pathway lying between the house of Manu Mondal and his nephew Sahadeb Mondal.
Sultan Khan was also murdered by them and they carried away his dead body to a grazing field and left it there.
respondent_arguments: The FIR was anti-dated, anti-timed or fabricated.
Not much reliance could be placed on the evidence of eye-witnesses as most of them are relatives of Amrita Dome and not a single independent witness was examined by the prosecution.
court_reasoning: The High Court correctly appreciated the evidence rendered by those witnesses.
The inquest report normally would not contain the manner in which the incident took place or the names of eye-witnesses as well as names of accused persons.
The basic purpose of holding an inquest is to report regarding the cause of death, namely whether it is suicidal, homicidal, accidental etc.
holding: The appeal filed by Guiram Mondal was dismissed and his conviction for murder and other offenses was upheld.
